boundaries: Support operations use actual Nest HTTP/auth, PostgreSQL transactions/constraints, Next and Chromium. They issue no provider call, financial mutation, entitlement change, or external message.
A support reply is an immutable operator statement, not verified payment evidence. The UNKNOWN case stays open; aged financial-command recovery and compensation remain separate work.

Six scenario groups include current scope/permission, invalid input, stable preview replay, concurrent commit, source/episode/expiry, read-only permission, cancel, 25+1 timestamp ties/foreign cursors, expired-copy, unreadable-reference return and committed response loss/original retry.
The PostgreSQL fault test simulates an audit persistence failure and a permission withdrawal during a lock wait; the rollback and row results use the actual database.
Counts overlap. This is not a new combined161 rerun or exhaustive C01-C08/LINE/Postmark acceptance. Native provider acceptance remains separate.
